description: Uses completed-bar close prices to emit an entry only when the fast simple moving average transitions from at-or-below to above the slow average, and an exit only on the inverse transition. A hypothetical fill can occur only at the next validated bar open.
display_name: SMA Close Crossing Long-Only Research Rule
known_limitations: Committed implementation accepts exactly one instrument per evaluation.
Long-only research rule with no short-selling behavior.
No claim of market validity, profitability, or future performance.
Validated here only against the committed daily synthetic equity fixture.
risk_characteristics: Entry size is capped by the Release 1 five-percent system position maximum.
No leverage, shorting, or increase to a losing position is permitted.
Open terminal positions remain marked rather than being force-liquidated.
